Our story

Inspired by the world of Franz Kafka and the bureaucracy of old Central Europe, Kafka Bank celebrates patience, paperwork, and the enduring mystery of administrative processes. Any resemblance to actual banks, institutions, procedures, or waiting periods is purely coincidental, though perhaps not entirely unfamiliar.

Kafka Bank is a fictional satirical institution created for artistic and entertainment purposes. It does not provide real financial services, accept deposits, issue loans, or offer investment advice.

All documents, accounts, forms, stamps, certificates, credit ratings, payment cards and other products presented under the Kafka Bank brand are part of an artistic fiction and serve solely as literary, graphic and cultural exaggeration. No information provided here constitutes financial advice, legal counsel or an offer of real banking services.

By entering this world, you accept that some applications may remain in processing forever and some decisions may never be definitively issued.

Our distinguished clients

Franz Kafka

1883–1924

Client No. 1. Insurance clerk by day, writer by night. His account was opened in perfect order, though no one can say exactly when.

Alfons Mucha

1860–1939

Client No. 2. Designed the first banknotes of Czechoslovakia, so he knows exactly what the bank is made of. His account is kept in the finest ornamental style.

Karel Čapek

1890–1938

Client No. 3. Gave the world the word “robot”. He insists that all his forms be processed by humans. We are still looking for them.

Sigmund Freud

1856–1939

Client No. 4. Born in Příbor, later of Vienna. He has analysed our waiting times and finds them deeply meaningful.

Jaroslav Hašek

1883–1923

Client No. 5. Author of The Good Soldier Švejk. He fills in every form with absolute obedience, which is why none has ever been accepted.

We proudly support

Foundation
for Patience

Waiting builds character. We fund the benches. Since its founding, the Foundation has supported thousands of clients in the noble art of waiting, providing seating, numbered tickets and a steady supply of reassuring announcements. Applications for support are processed in the order received, which is to say, eventually.

Kafka
Football League

Kafka Liga is a fictional football league proudly sponsored by Kafka Bank as its main partner. Every result remains provisional, every decision is under review, and the final standings are expected shortly. Pending approval, of course.

Certified Bureaucrat
Academy

Training the officials of tomorrow. Graduation certificates are issued within three to five years. The curriculum covers forms, stamps, corridors and the fine art of referring a client to another department. Our students can look forward to a bright future.
